requirements.text: Bachelor's degree or similar work experience
1-3 years of experience building and deploying production-level machine learning solutions or similar experience
1-3 years of strong programming experience with one of: Python, C++, C, C#, Java, Rust, or Go, or similar experience
Experience with web services and API frameworks such as Flask and FastAPI
Knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-based computing, including Azure
Ability to decompose problems, plan solutions, and design complex systems and interfaces
Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code
Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack, from user interface to database layer
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to peers and C-level executives
Self-starter, highly adaptive, and able to learn new technologies quickly
Excellent organization, project management, and multi-tasking skills
Must be legally authorized to work in the country of the job position without sponsorship
Familiarity with AI domains such as time series forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural language processing
